# The libraries the Linux driver may name in DT_NEEDED: the glibc libraries and each architecture's
# dynamic loader, and libkeyutils.so.1, the one dependency outside the base system
# (policy/host-prerequisites.txt). A driver that needs any other library fails verification until a
# reviewed edit adds it here. One file name per line.
libc.so.6
libdl.so.2
libm.so.6
libpthread.so.0
libresolv.so.2
librt.so.1
ld-linux-x86-64.so.2
ld-linux-aarch64.so.1
libkeyutils.so.1
